The last few months have been a wildly busy time for Apple. The company has launched new products like the iPhone Duo, MacBook Pro with PROLED, HomeView, HomePod mini 2, and much more.

As the year comes to a close, however, Apple still has a few more things to launch. Here’s what to expect.

9to5Mac is sponsored by Sony: Score Sony’s INZONE noise-canceling earbuds for 38% off. These deliver immersive 360 Spatial Sound, active noise canceling, low-latency wireless connectivity, and much more.

New products

New Product(RED) gear

According to Bloomberg, Apple is set to unveil its first new (Product)RED products in several years. The company is reportedly working on the following gear in Product(RED) color:

  • HomePod mini with a red mesh exterior
  • AirPods Max 2 with a silver finish, white mesh ear cups, a white headband, and a red Digital Crown
  • Red Apple Watch Sport Band
  • Red Wrist Strap for iPhone and AirPods Pro

9to5Mac has also heard from a source that Apple has developed a Product(RED) version of the AirTag item tracker. It’s unclear whether this will be released alongside the AirPods Max 2 and HomePod mini, though.

These products are expected to launch “on or around” December 1, which is World AIDS Day. Through its Product(RED) partnership, Apple donates a portion of the proceeds to the organization to support the fight against AIDS.

Apple Home Collection

Alongside HomeView, Apple announced a new Apple Home Collection lineup of smart home accessories. These were developed in partnership with LG and Schneider. At the time, Apple said that availability for some of the products would begin in December.

Apple officially opened pre-orders for select Apple Home Collection products earlier this month:

  • LG Video Doorbell: $249.95
  • LG Indoor Camera: $199.95
  • LG Outdoor Camera: $299.95

These products are estimated to be delivered in mid-December, a week or so before Christmas.

iOS 27.3

Finally, Apple will release iOS 27.3 sometime in December. This is a big update for iPhone users, with new features including:

  • Redesigned Health app
  • Face Unlock, Reachability, and more for iPhone Duo
  • All-new StandBy experience for iPhone
  • Apple Intelligence in China
  • Vertical Tabs and Adaptive Dark Mode in Safari
  • Selfie Sing in Apple Music

You can check out our full guide for everything new in iOS 27.3. The update will likely be released sometime around December 10. Apple will also release macOS 27.3, watchOS 27.3, and related updates in December.

Wrap up

What are you most excited to see from Apple as the year wraps up? Are you planning to order the new Product(RED) gear or Apple Home Collection? Let us know down in the comments.
